summary: Re-tested iteration 15 after partial-unique-index fix on db.reviews.order_id_1. All 16 tests in test_iter15_reviews_photos_and_tracking.py now pass (previously blocked by legacy unique index causing duplicate-null-key errors on multiple product reviews). Additionally verified via direct MongoDB inspection that `order_id_1` index carries `partialFilterExpression` — uniqueness now enforced only when order_id exists as a string.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter15 fully green. Partial index migration in seed_production() confirmed working. Restaurant-review dedupe still enforced (order_id present branch); product-review multi-post now succeeds (order_id absent branch skipped by partial filter). The supplementary test_product_review_twice_both_succeed was skipped because admin's /api/products list returned empty in this env — the main iter15 suite already validates multi-review persistence with its own product-creation fixture, so this is not a gap.
rca of the issue: Prior failure RCA: reviews collection had a legacy non-partial unique index on order_id which rejected 2nd insert of null-order_id (product reviews). Fix (in server.py seed_production ~L6317-6355) drops the legacy index and recreates as partial unique with filter {order_id: {$type: 'string'}}. Verified via db.reviews.index_information() showing partialFilterExpression on order_id_1.
